input.summary: Delete the clause that vests Corio-created Developments in Commerce One where it supports them
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot let our own interface code and configurations transfer to Commerce One simply because Commerce One supports them on an ongoing basis; ownership of what we build stays with us, with Commerce One keeping its pre-existing IP.

ops.oldText: shall be owned by Corio, unless such Developments are supported on an ongoing basis by Commerce One in which case Commerce One will retain all ownership rights, including
ops.newText: shall be owned by Corio. Commerce One shall not acquire any ownership rights, including

ops.oldText: intellectual property rights in the Developments. To the extent
ops.newText: intellectual property rights, in the Developments. To the extent

input.summary: Extend the warranty period to 90 days from acceptance and remove the fixed calendar cut-off
input.comment: [Playbook] A 60-day warranty running from the Effective Date and expiring on a fixed calendar date can lapse before the Software is even accepted; our fallback is 90 days from acceptance with the existing correct/replace/refund remedies unchanged.

ops.oldText: for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period")
ops.newText: for a period of ninety (90) days from the date of Corio's acceptance of the Software (the "Warranty Period")
